changes: PDF uploads are Draft/Hidden by default with per-item and bulk Show/Hide controls
Supabase mock tests are Draft/Hidden by default with per-test and bulk Show/Hide controls
CBT questions have individual and topic-wide student visibility controls
CBT public catalog returns only questions whose Topic and Question visibility are both enabled
Daily targets support Show Now, Automatic Date and Stop/Hide modes
The first five batch days are visible immediately as a preview; later targets publish automatically by date
Hidden PDFs and tests are blocked from direct student links
Existing flexible class timing, carry-forward, PDF verification and final-test flow are retained
Cloudflare PDF Worker and R2 remain unchanged
